profile.summary: Hi there! Welcome to my profile. Im expanding my network in the robotics field because I have a genuine passion for this amazing industry. Im continuously learning about new technologies and love exploring how robotics can change the future. Glad to connect and explore this amazing industry together with like-minded people, tech enthusiasts, and professionals. Feel free to reach out—let’s share ideas and learn from each other!

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented secure, transaction-driven microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and Spring MVC to support banking APIs for account management and payment workflows, processing 1M+ daily requests with sub-200ms response times. 
• Developed responsive front-end modules using React.js, integrating REST APIs for customer onboarding and transaction dashboards, reducing page load time by 32% and improving user task completion rates by 25%. 
• Enforced application-level security using Spring Security and JWT-based authentication, implementing role-based access control and token validation for internal and external banking users, lowering unauthorized access incidents by 40%. 
• Created and maintained event-driven data pipelines using Apache Kafka, AWS SNS, and SQS to handle real-time transaction notifications and audit events, ensuring 99.9% message delivery reliability across distributed systems. 
• Automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, executing JUnit test suites and deploying services to AWS via CloudFormation, while leveraging GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT API for code generation, reducing development and code review cycles by 30%.

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Built insurance domain microservices using Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Spring Data JPA to support policy issuance, claims processing, and underwriting workflows, handling 500K+ policy transactions per month with improved fault isolation across services. 
• Implemented distributed system communication using RabbitMQ and API Gateway, enabling asynchronous claim status updates and premium calculations, reducing inter-service latency by 28% and preventing cascading failures during peak traffic. 
• Developed scalable front-end applications using React.js, Redux, and Material UI, integrating REST APIs for policy management and claims dashboards, increasing UI responsiveness by 35% and reducing user-reported defects by 22%. 
• Secured RESTful services with OAuth 2.0, enforcing token-based authentication and authorization for internal agents and external partners, while storing transactional and document metadata in MongoDB and relational data in AWS RDS hosted on EC2. 
• Executed Agile delivery using Scrum, managing sprint work through Jira, containerizing services with Docker, validating APIs via Postman, and strengthening test coverage with Mockito, cutting production defects by 30% and improving release stability.

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Contributed to full SDLC delivery of Java-based applications using Spring Boot, Spring REST, and Spring ORM, supporting serviceoriented architecture for client management and internal operations, delivering 15+ production releases on schedule. 
• Established RESTful APIs and microservices using Java and Spring, designing service contracts and request/response models to enable modular integration across systems, improving service reusability by 25%. 
• Crafted interactive front-end components using Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, integrating backend APIs for dashboards and form-driven workflows, reducing UI rendering issues by 30%. 
• Accomplished database logic using MySQL and PL/SQL, optimizing queries and stored procedures for transactional modules, cutting report generation time by 35% and improving data consistency. 
• Automated build and deployment pipelines using Git and Jenkins, validated APIs with Postman, and supported TDD through unit and integration testing, while leveraging JMS for asynchronous message handling and deploying services on Azure environments.
